integrity: A complete analytic proof and separately executable finite consistency checks are supplied. Classical Airy formulae and zero asymptotics are credited. No independent publication-priority or mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies real ambiguity zeros of the unit-norm quartic-chirped Gaussian for nonzero real chirp. It does not classify complex-frequency zeros, all phase polynomials, or perturbations of the Gaussian envelope. Asymptotics hold for each fixed nonzero chirp; uniformity at zero chirp is not asserted.
title: Exact Airy folds and universal quadratic Doppler-threshold census for quartic-chirped Gaussian ambiguity
